remarks: Well maintained two bedrooms and 1.5 bathrooms condo/apt with updates including hardwood floor in living area, new carpet on staircase and a new AC/HEAT system (Nov, 2025). It has two spacious bedrooms on the second floor and a reasonable sized bathroom on the first floor.  On the main floor, it has a nice size kitchen and a spacious living room, and is equipped with washer and dryer It is in a small complex with an assigned parking, and additional parking for visitors.   It is in a relatively quiet area, within walking distance to downtown, parks, schools and is commuter friendly. It is also minutes away from major highways. It will be a great buy, so don't miss out.
